brief: @buildthis.bisks.net idea i had a while ago: for a handle's mutuals and/or for an app.bsky.graph.list, create a directed graph of liker->author likes, weight the edges by pointwise mutual information, run HITS on that, and calculate network clout as geometric mean of authority score and hub score
note: built cloutgraph: paste a handle or a bsky list link, it crawls who-liked-whom within that group off each account's own PDS, PMI-weights the edges, runs HITS, ranks by clout = sqrt(hub*authority).
